instruction: Extract the video frame at 00:03 and apply it as the background image for the first slide of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting a frame from landscape.mp4 at 00:03 and setting it as the background of slide 1 (index 0). Evaluator checks if slide 1 has a background image applied (state-based check, not pixel comparison).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly implements two-part verification: (1) checks background image exists AND (2) verifies it matches the video frame at 00:03
Getter properly extracts both the background image from PowerPoint and the reference frame from landscape.mp4 at 00:03 using ffmpeg
Metric uses perceptual hashing (imagehash library) to compare images semantically, handling format/compression differences appropriately
Partial credit logic is reasonable: 1.0 for very similar (hash_diff < 10), 0.7 for similar (hash_diff < 20), 0.3 for different
Postconfig correctly activates window and saves file to ensure fresh state extraction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add explicit verification that ffmpeg is available before attempting frame extraction (currently fails silently)
Consider making video path configurable instead of hardcoded to allow for reusable evaluator pattern
Improve error handling fallback: returning 0.5 when image comparison fails could give false positives - consider returning 0.0 instead
Add logging to help debug when image extraction or comparison fails
